title: Engine response to operation deps_graph (/io/response.json)
description: Import edges between the files of the candidate, read by the engine's own parser (Python AST, TypeScript compiler API). unresolved lists the imports the engine could not map to a file in the repo: they are reported, never dropped. In edges, from is the importer and to the imported file (the direction of contracts/examples/valid/integration__discovered.json).

error.description: Set when the engine cannot build the import graph; the edges of an error response are not a complete graph.
